story.text: 노랗게 익은 감귤이 주렁주렁 매달린 농장 안, 용우가 능숙하게 가지를 젖히며 길을 터준다.
story.reading: no-rat-ge ik-eun gam-gyul-i ju-reong-ju-reong mae-dal-lin nong-jang an, yong-u-ga neung-suk-a-ge ga-ji-reul jeoch-i-myeo gil-eul teo-jun-da.
story.en: Inside an orchard hung heavy with ripe yellow tangerines, Yongwoo skillfully pushes branches aside to clear a path.

story.text: '여기 감귤이 제일 달아. 먹어봐라.' 손수 딴 감귤 하나를 까서 내밀어준다.
story.reading: yeo-gi gam-gyul-i je-il dal-a. meog-eo-bwa-ra. son-su ttan gam-gyul ha-na-reul kka-seo nae-mil-eo-jun-da.
story.en: 'The tangerines here are the sweetest. Try one.' He peels one he picked himself and holds it out to me.

story.text: 농장 주인 아주머니가 다가와 웃으며 묻는다. '둘이 참 잘 어울린다이. 남매 사이라 그런가?'
story.reading: nong-jang ju-in a-ju-meo-ni-ga da-ga-wa us-eu-myeo mut-neun-da. dul-i cham jal eo-ul-lin-da-i. nam-mae sa-i-ra geu-reon-ga?
story.en: The orchard owner, an ajumma, approaches with a smile. 'You two really suit each other. Is it because you're siblings?'

story.text: '어울리긴 뭐가 어울려요, 동생인데.' 용우가 재빨리 대답하지만 목소리 끝이 살짝 떨린다.
story.reading: eo-ul-li-gin mwo-ga eo-ul-lyeo-yo, dong-saeng-in-de. yong-u-ga jae-ppal-li dae-dab-ha-ji-man mok-so-ri kkeut-i sal-jjak tteol-lin-da.
story.en: 'What do you mean we suit each other, she's my sibling.' Yongwoo answers quickly, but his voice wavers slightly at the end.

story.text: 아주머니가 '그럼 남자친구는 있고?' 하고 묻자, 용우가 눈에 띄게 당황하며 딴청을 부린다.
story.reading: a-ju-meo-ni-ga geu-reom nam-ja-chin-gu-neun it-go? ha-go mut-ja, yong-u-ga nun-e ttui-ge dang-hwang-ha-myeo ttan-cheong-eul bu-rin-da.
story.en: When the ajumma asks, 'Does she have a boyfriend, then?' Yongwoo visibly flusters and pretends to be busy with something else.

story.text: '그, 그건 내가 알 바 아니고…' 얼버무리며 괜히 감귤 상자만 뒤적인다. 귀끝이 빨개져 있었다.
story.reading: geu, geu-geon nae-ga al ba a-ni-go. eol-beo-mu-ri-myeo gwaen-hi gam-gyul sang-ja-man dwi-jeok-in-da. gwi-kkeut-i ppal-gae-jyeo iss-eot-da.
story.en: 'Th-that's none of my business...' He mumbles evasively, fiddling with a box of tangerines for no reason. The tips of his ears had gone red.

story.text: 농장을 나서며 장난스럽게 물었다. '그럼 나 뭐라고 부를 건데?' 용우가 걸음을 멈추더니 한참 만에 입을 뗀다. '…동생 아니면 뭐, 뭐라고 해야 되는데.'
story.reading: nong-jang-eul na-seo-myeo jang-nan-seu-reop-ge mul-eot-da. geu-reom na mwo-ra-go bu-reul geon-de? yong-u-ga geol-eum-eul meom-chu-deo-ni han-cham man-e ib-eul ttet-da. dong-saeng a-ni-myeon mwo, mwo-ra-go hae-ya doe-neun-de.
story.en: Leaving the orchard, I teasingly asked, 'So what are you going to call me, then?' Yongwoo stopped walking and, after a long pause, finally spoke. '...If not sibling, then what am I even supposed to call you.'

story.text: '됐다, 신경 쓰지 마라. 그것보다 오늘 대화 몇 개 들려줄 테니까 집중해서 들어봐.'
story.reading: dwaet-da, sin-gyeong sseu-ji ma-ra. geu-geot-bo-da o-neul dae-hwa myeot gae deul-lyeo-jul te-ni-kka jip-jung-hae-seo deul-eo-bwa.
story.en: 'Forget it, don't worry about it. More importantly, I've got a couple of conversations for you today — listen closely.'

words.example_en: Jeju tangerines have thin skin and a sweet-tart flavor.

words.example: 이 농장에서는 직접 감귤을 따서 먹어볼 수 있다.
words.example_reading: i nong-jang-e-seo-neun jik-jeop gam-gyul-eul tta-seo meog-eo-bol su it-da
words.example_en: At this farm you can pick and eat tangerines yourself.

words.meaning: To suit, go well together, match
words.example: 그 둘은 나란히 서 있으니 참 잘 어울렸다.
words.example_reading: geu dul-eun na-ran-hi seo iss-eu-ni cham jal eo-ul-lyeot-da
words.example_en: Standing side by side, the two of them really suited each other.

words.meaning: To mumble a vague answer, evade a question
words.example: 그는 질문에 제대로 답하지 않고 얼버무렸다.
words.example_reading: geu-neun jil-mun-e je-dae-ro dab-a-ji an-go eol-beo-mu-ryeot-da
words.example_en: He didn't answer the question properly and just gave a vague, evasive reply.

words.meaning: To be flustered, embarrassed, caught off guard
words.example_en: He was extremely flustered by the sudden question.

sentences.ko: 농장 아주머니는 우리가 참 잘 어울린다며 웃었다.
sentences.reading: nong-jang a-ju-meo-ni-neun u-ri-ga cham jal eo-ul-lin-da-myeo us-eot-da
sentences.en: The orchard ajumma smiled, saying we really suited each other.

sentences.ko: 남매 사이냐는 물음에 용우는 재빨리 동생이라고 대답했다.
sentences.reading: nam-mae sa-i-nya-neun mul-eum-e yong-u-neun jae-ppal-li dong-saeng-i-ra-go dae-dab-aet-da
sentences.en: When asked if we were siblings, Yongwoo quickly answered that I was his younger sibling.

sentences.ko: 남자친구가 있냐는 질문에 그는 눈에 띄게 당황했다.
sentences.reading: nam-ja-chin-gu-ga it-nya-neun jil-mun-e geu-neun nun-e ttui-ge dang-hwang-haet-da
sentences.en: Asked whether I had a boyfriend, he was visibly flustered.

sentences.ko: 그는 대답을 얼버무리며 괜히 감귤 상자만 뒤적였다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun dae-dab-eul eol-beo-mu-ri-myeo gwaen-hi gam-gyul sang-ja-man dwi-jeok-yeot-da
sentences.en: He mumbled an evasive answer, fiddling pointlessly with a box of tangerines.

sentences.ko: '동생 아니면 뭐라고 해야 되는데'라는 그의 말이 오래 마음에 남았다.
sentences.reading: dong-saeng a-ni-myeon mwo-ra-go hae-ya doe-neun-de-ra-neun geu-ui mal-i o-rae ma-eum-e nam-at-da
sentences.en: His words, 'if not sibling, then what am I supposed to call you,' stayed with me for a long time.

turns.speaker: 농장 아주머니
turns.text: 총각, 이 아가씨랑은 무슨 사이야? 손도 잘 잡아주고.
turns.reading: chong-gak, i a-ga-ssi-rang-eun mu-seun sa-i-ya? son-do jal jab-a-ju-go.
turns.en: Young man, what's your relationship with this lady? You hold her hand so naturally.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 동생이에요, 동생. 넘어질까 봐 그런 거예요.
turns.reading: dong-saeng-i-e-yo, dong-saeng. neom-eo-jil-kka bwa geu-reon geo-ye-yo.
turns.en: She's my younger sibling. I just didn't want her to fall.

turns.speaker: 농장 아주머니
turns.en: For a sibling, that look in your eyes seemed pretty serious.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.reading: geu-reon geo a-ni-e-yo. gam-gyul-i-na deo dam-a-deu-ril-ge-yo.
turns.en: ...It's not like that. Let me bag up some more tangerines for you.

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 용우가 얼버무리며 화제를 돌린 이유는?
dialogues.question_en: Why did Yongwoo evade the question and change the subject in this conversation?
dialogues.explanation: 아주머니가 눈빛이 예사롭지 않다고 정곡을 찌르자 용우는 당황하며 화제를 감귤로 돌렸습니다.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 아까 대답 왜 그렇게 얼버무렸어요? 동생 아니면 뭐냐니까.
turns.reading: a-kka dae-dab wae geu-reo-ke eol-beo-mu-ryeoss-eo-yo? dong-saeng a-ni-myeon mwo-nya-ni-kka.
turns.en: Why did you give such a vague answer earlier? You said 'if not sibling, then what.'

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 그, 그건… 나도 잘 모르겠으니까 그렇지.
turns.reading: geu, geu-geon na-do jal mo-reu-gess-eu-ni-kka geu-reo-chi.
turns.en: Th-that's... because I don't really know myself, that's why.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.en: Is there something even you don't know, Captain?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 있다, 있어. 요즘 자꾸 그런 게 생긴다, 너 때문에.
turns.reading: it-da, iss-eo. yo-jeum ja-kku geu-reon ge saeng-gin-da, neo ttae-mun-e.
turns.en: There is. There is. Lately there's been more and more of that — because of you.

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 알 수 있는 용우의 심리 상태로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best describes Yongwoo's emotional state in this conversation?
dialogues.correct_answer: 자신의 감정을 스스로도 확신하지 못해 혼란스러워하고 있다
options: 자신의 감정을 스스로도 확신하지 못해 혼란스러워하고 있다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 '동생'이라는 말 대신 뭐라 불러야 할지 스스로도 확신하지 못하며 혼란스러워하고 있습니다.
